data.notes: No November 2026 Ischgl listings were found on RA/DICE/Shotgun/Eventbrite for touring diaspora or promoter-party brands; the verified scene events are dated après-ski/club residencies and venue programmes.

events.title: Top of the Mountain Opening Concert: Westlife
events.venueName: Top of the Mountain Concerts (Silvretta Car Park East P1)
events.summary: Westlife headline Ischgl’s Top of the Mountain Opening Concert for the 2026/27 winter-season launch, with doors from 16:30 and the concert at 18:00. The official event page places the concert at Silvretta Car Park East (P1), with ticketing bundled into ski-pass products.

events.title: Trofana Alm Party de Luxe with International DJs
events.summary: Trofana Alm’s winter listing runs from 26 November 2026 to 2 May 2027 and describes the venue as a legendary après-ski club with regular international DJ visits and state-of-the-art sound technology.

events.title: Kuhstall Winter Après-Ski DJ Residency
events.summary: Kuhstall confirms it returns on 20 November 2026, with daily après-ski into open end; its own listing describes one of the best-known Alpine party venues, international partygoers, dancing, entertainment, and DJs.

events.title: fire & ice APRES.SKI Club Winter Nights
events.summary: The official Ischgl A–Z listing confirms fire & ice APRES.SKI from 26 November 2026 to 2 May 2027 as an après-ski, bar, club and dancing venue for meeting people and dancing through the night.

events.title: Freeride Après Clubbing Winter Residency
events.summary: Freeride’s dated winter listing runs from 26 November 2026 to 2 May 2027 and bills an every-afternoon Après Clubbing format where DJs drive the dancefloor until late.

events.title: SPACE 73 Changing Electronic DJ Sets
events.summary: SPACE 73’s official listing confirms winter opening from 26 November 2026 to 1 May 2027 and describes the bar-lounge-club programme as changing DJ sets featuring quality electronic music.

events.title: Niki’s Stadl DJ Partyhits Winter Residency
events.summary: Niki’s Stadl is confirmed from 25 November 2026 to 2 May 2027, with daily après-ski from 15:00 and DJs playing current party hits in a long-running Ischgl party venue.
